caveats: The stock lists are today's index members, so companies that left the index earlier are missing (survivorship bias): past results look better than an investor at the time could have done.
Every past trade is charged with today's rate card.
Prices are adjusted for splits and dividends; taxes on gains are not included.
The risk-free rate is today's (RBI 91-day T-bill auction cut-off yield 5.2599%, press release 2 Sep 2026: https://rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63500) for every past day.
